lines.speaker: At the axle
lines.text: Small flecks of crow-black paint cling to the iron. A scratched token lies close by. Someone carried both along this road.

lines.speaker: At the axle
lines.text: The iron moves a little in the current of air above the ford. Only the water answers now.

lines.speaker: At the axle
lines.text: The wood is smooth where Kael laid his knuckles. He gave the empty-hand sign here.

lines.speaker: At the axle
lines.text: Kael remembers the length of the pause across the ford. He let the ring hang.
